description: Assign guests to a random seating chart grid — set rows and columns, paste the guest list, and shuffle until everyone has a seat.

faqs.a: Guests are shuffled with Fisher-Yates and dealt into seats left to right, top to bottom.
Seat numbers run 1..N across rows, so you can print the chart and label tables easily.
Extra seats stay empty, and if there are more guests than seats you get a clear error asking to add rows or columns.
Press Shuffle again — every press re-randomizes the whole chart.
Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.

howto: Set the number of rows and columns for your room layout.
Paste one guest name per line.
Press Assign seats — shuffle again any time.
title: Seating Chart Maker
